items.quote: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac
items.claim: The LORD appeared above the location and identified himself as the God of Abraham and Isaac

items.quote: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed
items.claim: The LORD promises to give the land Jacob is lying on to him and his descendants

items.quote: thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth
items.claim: Jacob's seed shall become as numerous as the dust of the earth

items.quote: thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south
items.claim: Jacob's seed shall spread in all four cardinal directions

items.quote: in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed
items.claim: All families of the earth shall be blessed through Jacob and his seed
items.object: all the families of the earth
